assessment.status_recommendation: KEEP LEADING_CANDIDATE_PENDING_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE (not primary-evidence-supported; evidence insufficient). Recommend the owner additionally annotate EV-08: the CR >= 3500 figure is unverified and possibly not a throat-rotor value; the ~60 % is a DSMC value (56.47-57.85 % high-speed case).
reasoning: The Li 2015 full text was not legitimately accessible (ScienceDirect 403; closed per OpenAlex/Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar); the A4 condition 'verified from a first-hand source' is therefore NOT met.

Abstract content (search-engine excerpts, consistent across queries) reframes EV-08: the capture efficiency is DSMC (model-derived), and only the storage chain (small TMP + scroll pump) was tested experimentally, reaching ~atmospheric pressure; the throat-scale 'big turbo' rotor, which is the C1 element, appears to be simulation-only.
No accessible text states CR >= 3500; its species, stage, inlet pressure and throughput remain unknown, so HG-4 (CR on atomic O, 2.37-142) cannot be credited from it even if verified.

Positive consistency: the 500 mm inlet (0.196 m^2) lies within the repo's minimum-inlet range 0.098-0.377 m^2, supporting the throat-spanning-rotor topology as physically plausible (not demonstrated).
No independent group has published numbers on a rotor-based ABEP compressor; secondary sources flag angular momentum and vibration (MOON2024 excerpt) - relevant to T-9.
C1's leading status rests on the physics bounds (EV-01/EV-03/EV-20 pumping-speed argument), not on Li 2015; so demotion is not warranted either.
what_would_close_it: First-hand read of LI2015 via legitimate access (institutional subscription, library ILL, or purchase) extracting: CR definition, species, inlet/outlet pressure, throughput, which stage(s) the 3500 refers to, simulation vs experiment, rpm, blade geometry, power, mass.

Even then, DI-1.4 freeze per the repo's own rule needs Vyovrinda/vendor test data T-1..T-5, T-8 (CR vs inlet pressure 1e-3-1e-1 Pa for N2/O2 on a throat-scale rotor, pumping speed vs rpm, AO-bearing flow, bus power, T_feed, back-streaming) and T-6, T-7, T-9 for Milestone C.
Optionally: first-hand reads of LI2014A/LI2014B (TMP DSMC model basis) to judge the fidelity of the rotor simulation.
